name: Houjou Satoshi
source:
He is [url=/c3789]Satoko[/url]'s older brother and a member of the Hinamizawa Fighters baseball team.
He has a quiet and timid personality, but he is brave enough to get himself hurt for Satoko.
He disappeared a few years ago due to being demoned away.

[spoiler]Satoshi developed terminal symptoms of Hinamizawa Syndrome due to his aunt's abuse and murdered her with a baseball bat on the night of the festival in 1982. As of 1983, Satoshi has remained in the clinic's basement in a comatose state as [url=/c3828]Irie[/url] searches for a cure.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Satoshi_Houjou]Satoshi Houjou[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
